Section 3.1 deals with the general concept of approximation of a normed space
                 and Section 3.2 contains a general convergence theorem for the approximation of a
                 general variational problem. In the last section and throughout all of Section 4 we
                 describe some particular approximations of the basic space V of the Navier–Stokes
                 equations. We give the corresponding numerical scheme for the Stokes equations
                 and then apply the general convergence theorem to this case.                 
                    In section 3.3 we consider the finite difference method. Finite element method
                 will be treated in the next section (Section 4; 4.1 to 4.5).                 
                    The approximations of the space V introduced here will be used throughout 
                 subsequent chapters, and they will be referred to as (APX1), (APX2), ... .
